title: Implement staged checkout media and private owner photo reads
acceptance_criteria: Reuse the private image primitive for bounded multipart checkout uploads with quotas, MIME/magic/decode validation and disconnect handling. Bind staged grants and records to tenant, checkout session, attempt and purpose.
Stream order photos only through scoped owner handlers; deny anonymous and other-owner access. Never expose S3 keys, storage credentials, signed/bearer URLs or media URLs on anonymous receipts.

On real private S3 and PostgreSQL verify direct object denial, invalid/reused/foreign upload rejection, interruption and DB-failure compensation, and idempotent staged TTL/orphan cleanup that leaves attached photos intact.
deliverables: Checkout uploads and grants, owner photo streaming, cleanup/reconciliation and storage evidence
